reviews.review: If doom and borderlands had a baby made with roguelike elements. Also, the music is amazing.

Definitely pick this up if you are looking for some roguelike that is fast, and rewards your time. There isn't a ton of content at the moment, but the core of the game is so good, it doesn't really feel that repetitive, and since each level has a ranking system from F to S, also gives you reinforcement to improve all the time. 

Beat the game on normal, and hard mode now. Definitely need some RNG to finish a run, since the final levels are brutal, but the balance everywhere else is good. I think the game needs some reasons to go to different paths besides the optimal alternate paths once you unlock them, but really the reason to play the game is to try new combinations of perks, and enjoy the blazing fast action. 

Easily better combat than Gunfire, and pretty similar variety of content. Definitely recommend at this stage of development, and it can only get better from here.

Roboquest is a joy to play, with a decent skill ceiling and satisfying weapons.
Guns feel great in this game and I typically lean more towards the throwing knives and bows as they feel powerful and accurate without the downside of reload time.
The art style is endearing and easy on the eyes; that cartoony cel-shaded look paired with visual gun sounds is a really cool aesthetic and it's one of this games biggest pulls for me. Unlocking skills is fun and finding new mods through each secret or level start keeps you on your toes to find that perfect run. Each different bot can really change up the gameplay style as you unlock new ones. 

However this game is not without its nitpicks, so I'll give some of my personal feedback on what I'd like to see more of...

The movement could be better as needing to press the sprint button constantly is a bit annoying, so maybe just a set run speed or an option for auto-run would be better? Sliding is something I never really use because you don't slide very far and it feels a little weak, so maybe increase the distance of the slide a little bit as well as briefly increase the field of view to take in the surroundings for a moment? I also feel a ledge-grabbing/mounting mechanic would be a good addition because trying to reach higher spots in the heat of battle can sometimes be tedious and having that extra bit of verticality would make combat more enjoyable.

At this stage I feel the game has a solid foundation for a complete release and is incredibly fun and addictive as is. But with it being early access there are some things I would love to see added in order to make the game feel more whole. I do believe that more people should play this as it's a diamond in the rough.
This game is AMAZING, highly recommend
